beschreibung: Edge of the Lämmeren Glacier (Lämmerengletscher), the small glacier descending from the Schwarzhorn above the Lämmerenhütte. The glacier has retreated strongly; at this point only a thin remnant of ice is left, partly covered by debris and cut by crevasses and meltwater channels.
schaetzung: Own estimate from the site visit, not yet backed by measurements: at the present rate of melting, the remaining ice here could disappear within roughly two to four years.
